title: Majority computation step
statement: Given a language $V$ of Boolean lists and natural numbers $a$ and $k$, define a state update on Boolean lists using the block-loop step operation. Its update decodes the state as a pair, tests whether the specified length-$k$ slice of the second component belongs to $V$, and encodes the corresponding updated nested pair together with the remaining slice.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language of Boolean lists
Input state is a Boolean list
caveat: The definitions of the block-loop step, slicing, and pair encoding and decoding are not included, so the update cannot be rendered more explicitly.
